verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical. Both split the design into two separate panels. On the left, a flat teal card holds the quote frame; on the right, the dog photo has lost its teal duotone overlay and shows in full orange colour. That breaks the original's single layered look and its colour scheme. Both also leave wide white gutters and margins around the panels, the quote text is small inside a tall, narrow box, and the left-hand quote mark and pattern icons are crammed against the edges, so it reads as two pasted-in assets rather than a deliberate resize.
